tasks.title: Create Project Structure and Initial Setup
tasks.description: Set up the basic project structure, initialize version control, and configure development environment
tasks.details: Initialize a new project repository with appropriate folder structure (src/, docs/, tests/, config/). Set up .gitignore, README.md, and basic configuration files. Choose and configure package manager (npm/yarn for Node.js, pip for Python, etc.). Set up development environment with necessary tools and dependencies.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project structure is created correctly, all configuration files are present, and development environment can be successfully initialized on a clean system.

subtasks.title: Initialize Git Repository and Version Control
subtasks.description: Set up version control system with Git repository initialization and basic configuration
subtasks.details: Initialize a new Git repository using 'git init'. Configure Git user settings (name and email). Create initial commit structure. Set up remote repository connection if using GitHub/GitLab. Configure branch protection rules and establish main/develop branch strategy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify Git repository is properly initialized, check Git configuration settings, confirm remote repository connection, and validate initial commit structure

subtasks.title: Create Project Directory Structure
subtasks.description: Establish organized folder hierarchy for the project with standard directories
subtasks.details: Create main project directories: src/ for source code, docs/ for documentation, tests/ for test files, config/ for configuration files. Add subdirectories as needed (components/, utils/, assets/, etc.). Ensure proper naming conventions and logical organization of folders.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all required directories are created with correct names and structure, check directory permissions, and validate folder hierarchy matches project standards

subtasks.title: Configure Package Manager and Dependencies
subtasks.description: Set up package manager and install initial project dependencies
subtasks.details: Choose appropriate package manager (npm, yarn, pip, composer, etc.) based on project technology. Initialize package configuration file (package.json, requirements.txt, composer.json). Install core development dependencies and production libraries. Configure dependency version locking and security scanning.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify package manager initialization, test dependency installation process, check for security vulnerabilities in dependencies, and validate version locking mechanisms

subtasks.title: Create Essential Configuration Files
subtasks.description: Generate and configure essential project files including .gitignore, README, and environment configs
subtasks.details: Create comprehensive .gitignore file for the chosen technology stack. Write detailed README.md with project description, setup instructions, and usage guidelines. Set up environment configuration files (.env templates, config.json). Create EditorConfig and linting configuration files (ESLint, Prettier, etc.).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify .gitignore properly excludes unwanted files, validate README completeness and accuracy, test environment configuration loading, and check linting rules enforcement

subtasks.title: Set Up Development Environment and Tools
subtasks.description: Configure development environment with necessary tools, IDE settings, and build processes
subtasks.details: Configure IDE/editor settings and extensions. Set up build tools and scripts (webpack, gulp, make, etc.). Configure development server and hot reloading. Set up debugging tools and profilers. Create development workflow scripts for common tasks (start, build, test, deploy).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test development server startup, verify hot reloading functionality, validate build process execution, test debugging tools integration, and confirm all development scripts work correctly

subtasks.title: Run Unit Tests and Verify Build Compilation
subtasks.description: Execute unit tests and verify that the application builds successfully without compilation errors
subtasks.details: Run all unit tests using the test runner (npm test, jest, vitest, etc.) to ensure all test suites pass. Execute npm run build (or equivalent build command) to verify the application compiles successfully without TypeScript errors, build errors, or warnings. Fix any failing tests or compilation errors. Ensure build output is generated correctly and all assets are properly bundled.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run npm test to verify all unit tests pass. Run npm run build to verify successful compilation. Check for TypeScript errors, build warnings, and ensure build output directory is created with expected files. Verify no runtime errors in the built application.

tasks.title: Define Core Data Models and Schema
tasks.description: Design and implement the fundamental data structures and database schema for the application
tasks.details: Create entity relationship diagrams and define core data models. Implement database schema with appropriate tables, relationships, and constraints. Set up migration scripts for database versioning. Define data validation rules and constraints at the model level.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for data model validation, test database migrations up and down, verify referential integrity constraints, and validate data type enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication and Authorization System
tasks.description: Build user authentication, session management, and role-based access control
tasks.details: Implement user registration and login functionality with secure password hashing (bcrypt/scrypt). Set up JWT or session-based authentication. Create middleware for route protection and role-based access control. Implement password reset functionality with secure token generation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration/login flows, verify password security, test session management, validate access control for different user roles, and test password reset functionality.

tasks.testStrategy: Test all CRUD operations, verify transaction rollback scenarios, test database connection handling, validate data integrity, and test caching mechanisms.

tasks.testStrategy: Test search accuracy and performance, verify filtering and sorting functionality, test pagination with large datasets, and validate search result relevance.

tasks.title: Add Logging, Monitoring, and Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, and error tracking systems
tasks.details: Set up structured logging with appropriate log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Implement error tracking and monitoring using tools like Sentry or custom solutions. Add performance monitoring and health check endpoints. Create log rotation and retention policies.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify log generation at appropriate levels, test error tracking and alerting, validate monitoring metrics collection, and test health check endpoints.

subtasks.title: Set up structured logging system with log levels
subtasks.description: Implement a comprehensive structured logging system with appropriate log levels (debug, info, warn, error) throughout the application
subtasks.details: Configure logging framework (e.g., Winston for Node.js, Logback for Java, or Python logging). Set up structured JSON logging format with consistent fields like timestamp, level, message, service name, and request ID. Implement log level configuration through environment variables. Add contextual logging with correlation IDs for request tracing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify logs are generated at correct levels, test log format consistency, validate log level filtering, and ensure sensitive data is not logged

subtasks.title: Implement error tracking and monitoring system
subtasks.description: Set up error tracking and monitoring using Sentry or similar tools to capture and analyze application errors
subtasks.details: Integrate Sentry SDK or custom error tracking solution. Configure error capture for unhandled exceptions, API errors, and custom error events. Set up error grouping and deduplication. Implement error context capture including user information, request details, and stack traces. Configure alert thresholds and notification channels.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test error capture for different error types, verify error grouping and deduplication, validate alert notifications, and test error context information

subtasks.title: Add performance monitoring and metrics collection
subtasks.description: Implement performance monitoring to track application metrics, response times, and resource usage
subtasks.details: Set up application performance monitoring (APM) tools or custom metrics collection. Track key metrics like response times, throughput, error rates, and resource utilization. Implement custom business metrics and counters. Set up dashboards for real-time monitoring using tools like Grafana or built-in monitoring solutions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify metrics collection accuracy, test dashboard functionality, validate performance threshold alerts, and test metrics under load conditions

subtasks.title: Create health check endpoints and system status monitoring
subtasks.description: Implement health check endpoints to monitor application and dependency status for load balancers and monitoring systems
subtasks.details: Create /health and /ready endpoints that check application status, database connectivity, external service availability, and resource health. Implement different health check levels (liveness, readiness, startup probes). Add dependency health checks for databases, caches, and external APIs. Return appropriate HTTP status codes and detailed health information.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test health endpoints under normal and failure conditions, verify dependency health checks, validate response formats, and test integration with load balancers

subtasks.title: Configure log rotation and retention policies
subtasks.description: Set up log rotation, archival, and retention policies to manage log storage and comply with data retention requirements
subtasks.details: Configure log rotation based on file size and time intervals. Set up log archival to compressed formats or external storage (S3, Azure Blob). Implement retention policies to automatically delete old logs based on age and compliance requirements. Configure log shipping to centralized logging systems if needed. Set up log backup and recovery procedures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test log rotation triggers, verify log archival and compression, validate retention policy enforcement, and test log recovery procedures
